title: Under the Clouds — focused Jatoi NISAR/GFM cross-date satellite evidence audit
scope_note: Geographically and methodologically separate from earlier 290 cluster / 5679 pixel dashboard map study
limitations: reference is satellite estimate not ground truth
reference date is one day earlier than later NISAR acquisition
retrieved 500-item STAC sample may not cover every observation
candidate-focused overlap alone does not establish precision recall F1
study candidates are not a confirmed flood area
cropland exposure and crop damage not validated
modest descriptive lift vs baseline does not establish predictive skill
candidate study area manually selected, not randomized independent holdout
baseline_interpretation: Descriptive GFM flood prevalence (4.31%) vs candidate overlap (5.76%); lift ~1.34x. Not an independent accuracy metric, not statistical significance, not ground truth.
study_window_selection: Exploratory locality-focused box around Jatoi NISAR-covered anchor; selected before direct EODC GFM audit, but not a randomized/preregistered spatial holdout. Chronology and earlier contextual exposure should be independently documented.
